item.title: PPP Candidates Say "It's Like Calling Lee a Criminal" Over Special Counsel Bill That Can Drop Lee's Indictment (‘李 공소 취소' 특검법에... 국힘 후보들 “李는 범죄자라 외친 꼴”)
item.description:
PPP Candidates Say "It's Like Calling Lee a Criminal" Over Special Counsel Bill That Can Drop Lee's Indictment (‘李 공소 취소' 특검법에... 국힘 후보들 “李는 범죄자라 외친 꼴”)

After the Democratic Party of Korea proposed a special counsel bill on the 30th that could dismiss the indictment in President Lee Jae-myung’s case, candidates from the People Power Party (PPP) for metropolitan government positions launched a wave of criticism on the 1st. (더불어민주당이 지난 30일 이재명 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있는 특검법을 발의하자, 국민의힘 광역단체장 후보들이 1일 일제히 비판에 나섰다.)

The special counsel bill, designed by former defense lawyers for President Lee within the Democratic Party, targets not only seven cases, including the Daejang-dong and Wirye New Town development scandals and the Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance case, but also cases involving President Lee, such as violations of the Public Official Election Act, allegations of instigating perjury, the Baekhyeon-dong development scandal, bribery in Seongnam FC, and the corporate card misuse allegations. The special counsel would also be able to decide whether to maintain or drop the indictment, meaning a special counsel appointed by President Lee could dismiss the indictment in his own cases. (민주당 내 이재명 대통령 변호인 출신 의원들이 설계한 특검법안상 수사 대상은 대장동·위례 신도시 개발비리, 쌍방울 대북 송금 사건 등 7개 외에도 이 대통령 관련 사건인 공직선거법 위반, 위증 교사 의혹, 백현동 개발 비리, 성남 FC 뇌물, 법인카드 유용 의혹 사건 등이다. 특검은 해당 사건의 공소 유지 여부도 판단할 수 있게 해, 이 대통령이 임명한 특검이 이 대통령 사건의 공소 취소도 할 수 있게 해놨다.)

PPP Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon said on Facebook that day, "They already increased the number of Supreme Court justices to block President Lee Jae-myung’s guilty verdict, and now they’re trying to create an extra-legal monster special counsel to erase the indictment itself." He added, "They’ve crossed a line they shouldn’t have crossed—far beyond it. If warnings are ignored, we must resist and judge. We must save South Korea from falling into the swamp of dictatorship in this local election." (국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장 후보는 이날 페이스북에서 “이재명 대통령 유죄 판결을 원천 봉쇄하기 위해 대법관 숫자 자체를 늘리더니, 이제는 공소 자체를 지워버리기 위해 초법적 괴물 특검을 만들겠다고 한다”고 했다. 그는 “넘지 말아야 할 선을 넘어도 한참 넘었다. 경고를 듣지 않으면 저항하고 심판해야 한다”며 “독재의 늪으로 빠지는 대한민국을 이번 지방선거에서 구해야 한다”고 했다.)

Candidate Oh said, "It’s a special counsel that can forcibly take over most cases related to President Lee Jae-myung that the prosecution is investigating and maintaining indictments, and then dismiss those indictments." He continued, "But the special counsel is effectively nominated by the Democratic Party and selected by the president. This is more dangerous and worse than a criminal bribing the prosecutor who indicted them to get the indictment dropped." (오 후보는 “검찰이 수사·공소 유지 중인 이재명 대통령과 관련한 대부분의 사건을 강제로 뺏어 와서 공소를 취소할 수 있는 특검”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “그런데 그 특검을 사실상 민주당이 추천하고 대통령이 고르게 돼 있다”며 “이것은 범죄자가 자신을 기소한 검사를 매수해서 공소를 취소하게 만드는 것보다도 위험하고 나쁘다”고 했다.)

Candidate Oh said, "The ruling party is misusing its majority in the National Assembly to enact dictatorial unconstitutional laws, and the president plans to wield that law as a weapon to neuter the prosecution that indicted him." He added, "If he’s confident in his innocence and aboveboard, and if the prosecution’s indictment is clearly illegal, he should stand trial." He further stated, "During President Lee’s term, 22 out of 26 Supreme Court justices will be appointed by him. Yet, seeing such behavior close to an unconstitutional coup, it’s like shouting to the people that the president is a criminal." (오 후보는 “집권 세력이 국회 다수 권력을 악용해 독재 악법을 만들어 바치고, 대통령은 그 법을 무기 삼아 자신을 기소한 검찰을 무력화하겠다는 것”이라며 “스스로 결백을 확신한다면, 떳떳하다면, 그리고 검찰 공소가 분명 불법이라면 재판을 받으면 된다”고 했다. 그는 “이재명 대통령 임기 동안 대법관 26명 중 22명을 이 대통령이 임명한다”며 “그럼에도 이 같은 초헌법적 쿠데타에 가까운 행태를 벌이는 것을 보면, 국민에게 ‘대통령은 범죄자’라고 외치는 꼴”이라고 했다.)

PPP Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon also said on Facebook that day, "Is South Korea a nation for creating a get-out-of-jail-free card for one powerful person? This is a frontal challenge to the democratic constitutional order." Candidate Park said, "The Democratic Party has unilaterally passed many unconstitutional laws so far, but I never imagined they would fatally violate the constitution and the rule of law by granting the special counsel the power to dismiss indictments in cases where President Lee is the defendant." (국민의힘 박형준 부산시장 후보도 이날 페이스북에서 “대한민국이 권력자 한 사람 면죄부 만들어주기 위한 나라냐”며 “이것은 민주 헌정 질서에 대한 정면 도전”이라고 했다. 박 후보는 “민주당은 지금까지 많은 위헌적 법률을 일방적으로 통과시켜 왔지만, 이재명 대통령이 피고인인 사건에 대한 공소 취소 권한을 특검에게 부여할 만큼 헌법과 법치주의를 치명적으로 위반할 줄은 상상도 못했다”고 했다.)

Candidate Park said, "A special counsel appointed by the president having the power to dismiss an indictment is a declaration that the president stands above the law. It’s an anti-democratic outrage that blatantly privatizes the sovereignty entrusted by the people." He added, "They might as well declare that the burden is the state and the law." (박 후보는 “대통령이 임명하는 특검이 공소 취소권을 갖는다는 것은 대통령이 법 위에 서겠다는 선언”이라며 “국민이 위임한 주권을 노골적으로 사유화하는 반민주 폭거”라고 했다. 그러면서 “차라리 짐이 곧 국가요 법이라고 선언하라”고 했다.)

Candidate Park said, "They might get away with a pardon today through the power of a majority in the National Assembly. But tomorrow, they will surely stand in the court of history. Even if they avoid the judgment of today’s court, they cannot escape the judgment of history tomorrow." He added, "Our people must also stop this outrage that insults the constitution and the people. A strong popular resistance against this unprincipled act must rise starting right now." (박 후보는 “국회 다수 의석의 힘으로 오늘은 면죄부를 받을 수 있을지도 모른다”며 “하지만 내일은 반드시 역사의 법정에 서게 될 것입니다. 오늘 법정의 심판을 면할 수 있을지 몰라도 내일 역사의 심판을 면할 수는 없을 것”이라고 했다. 그는 “우리 국민도 헌법을 모욕하고 국민을 모욕하는 이 폭거만큼은 반드시 막아야 한다”며 “바로 지금부터 이 무도한 일에 대한 강력한 국민적 저항이 일어나야 한다”고 했다.)

PPP Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho said on KBS Radio that day, "They recently launched a parliamentary investigation citing fabricated indictments, but that actually proved there was no basis for it and instead demonstrated the legitimacy of the indictments." He continued, "The current form of the National Assembly is trying to act as another judiciary within the judiciary. It’s an attempt to destroy the separation of powers." Candidate Choo said, "What, they want a special counsel appointed by the president to overturn the decision to maintain the indictment in the president's own case? Are they trying to give themselves a pardon? Will the people tolerate this?" (국민의힘 추경호 대구시장 후보는 이날 KBS 라디오에서 “최근에 조작 기소 등을 이유로 국정조사를 했는데, 그 자체도 사실은 전혀 근거가 없고 기소의 정당성을 오히려 증명했다”며 “최근 국회의 형태가 사법부의 또 다른 사법부 역할을 하려 한다. 삼권 분립을 파괴하려는 시도”라고 했다. 추 후보는 “도대체 대통령이 지명하는 특검이 대통령 사건의 공소 유지 여부를 뒤집는 그런 또 특검을 하겠다(고 한다)”며 “셀프 면죄부 주려고 하느냐. 이걸 국민께서 용납하시겠느냐”고 했다.)

Candidate Choo said, "This is an attempt to destroy the rule of law and the separation of powers. If they force through legislation like this, there will definitely be a backlash." He added, "South Korea is a liberal democracy with a clear separation of powers. They must recognize that the future of South Korea is deeply concerning, and the people are watching this issue with great anxiety." (추 후보는 “이것이야말로 법치주의와 삼권분립 파괴를 시도하는 행위”라며 “이런 식으로까지 무리하게 입법을 시도하면 그 역풍은 반드시 있다”고 했다. 그는 “대한민국은 자유민주주의고 삼권분립이 명확한 곳”이라며 “대한민국의 미래가 심히 걱정되고 국민께서 몹시 걱정스러운 마음으로 이 문제를 쳐다보고 있다는 걸 인식해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "I will open a path of coexistence where labor and business go together" (李대통령 “노동과 기업이 함께가는 상생의 길 열겠다”)
item.description:
President Lee: "I will open a path of coexistence where labor and business go together" (李대통령 “노동과 기업이 함께가는 상생의 길 열겠다” )

On Labor Day, President Lee Jae-myung said, "A society that respects labor and a country that is good for businesses can fully coexist," adding, "I will open a path of coexistence where labor and business go together." (이재명 대통령은 노동절인 1일 “노동 존중 사회와 기업 하기 좋은 나라는 충분히 양립할 수 있다”며 “노동과 기업이 함께 가는 상생의 길을 열겠다”고 말했다.)

At the Labor Day ceremony held at the Blue House, President Lee stated, "We can move toward a better future when we break the old dichotomy that pro-labor means anti-business and pro-business means anti-labor." He further said, "I will create an ecosystem of coexistence where labor and management can communicate with mutual respect," and pledged, "I will realize true growth where labor and business, fairness and innovation, and growth and distribution create a virtuous cycle." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 노동절 기념식에서 “친노동은 반기업, 친기업은 반노동이라는 낡은 이분법을 깰 때 우리는 더 나은 미래로 나아갈 수 있다”며 이같이 말했다. 그러면서 “노사가 서로 존중하며 대화할 수 있는 상생의 생태계를 조성하겠다”며 “노동과 기업, 공정과 혁신, 성장과 분배가 선순환하는 진짜 성장을 실현하겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee remarked, "We are standing at the center of a great transformation," referencing the outlook that the introduction of artificial intelligence (AI) will lead to machines and AI replacing most of the labor done by humans. He said, "We must not unilaterally force sacrifices on workers solely for the sake of productivity improvement," adding, "Growth without a future for the workers, who make up the majority of the people, cannot be called true growth." He continued, "The government will pay special attention to ensuring that every working citizen can build their lives more safely, more fairly, and more confidently in the process of this great transition." (이 대통령은 “우리는 지금 거대한 변화의 한가운데 서 있다”며 인공지능(AI) 도입으로 인간이 하는 노동의 대부분을 기계와 AI가 대체하게 될 것이라는 전망을 언급했다. 이 대통령은 “생산성 향상만을 위해 노동자에게 일방적 희생을 강요해서는 안 된다”며 “국민 대다수인 노동자의 미래가 없는 성장은 진짜 성장이라고 할 수 없다”고 했다. 이어 “정부는, 대전환의 과정에서 일하는 국민 한 분 한 분이 더 안전하고, 더 공정하며, 더 당당하게 자신의 삶을 꾸려 나갈 수 있도록 각별히 살피겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee emphasized "safety in the workplace," a point he has stressed since the beginning of his administration, stating, "I will surely create a country where workers do not have to risk death." He added, "I will make clear that ensuring safety is not a cost or an option, but a fundamental duty that the state and businesses must uphold." (이 대통령은 집권 초부터 강조해온 ‘일터에서의 안전’을 다시 한번 강조하며 “노동자가 죽음을 무릅쓰지 않아도 되는 나라를 반드시 만들겠다”고 했다. “안전을 지키는 것은 비용이나 선택이 아닌, 국가와 기업이 반드시 지켜야 할 기본적인 책무라는 점을 분명히 하겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee said, "I will ensure that all workers can enjoy their basic labor rights," pledging, "I will pay special attention so that regular and non-regular workers, prime contractors and subcontractors, platform workers and freelancers—anyone who works—receives fair treatment and no protection blind spots arise." He added, "The size of one's rights should not differ simply because of differences in employment type or working method." (이 대통령은 “모든 노동자가 노동 기본권을 누릴 수 있도록 하겠다”며 “정규직과 비정규직, 원청과 하청, 플랫폼 노동자와 프리랜서까지, 일하는 사람이라면 누구나 공정한 대우를 받고 보호의 사각지대가 생기지 않도록 각별히 살피겠다”고 했다. “고용 형태와 일하는 방식이 다르다는 이유로 권리의 크기가 달라져서는 안 된다”고 했다.)

President Lee also mentioned his childhood as a "child laborer." Recalling those days, he said, "I would wake up early in the morning and head to the workplace, and late at night, sometimes until dawn, I would end the day with oil-stained hands." He admitted, "It would be a lie to say it wasn't exhausting," but added, "The sweat I shed from labor allowed me to support my family, which was a great comfort to me and the strength that made me who I am today." (이 대통령은 ‘소년공’이었던 어린 시절도 언급했다. 이 대통령은 소년공 시절 “이른 아침에 일어나 일터로 향하고, 늦은 밤 때로는 동트는 새벽이 되어서야 기름때가 묻은 손으로 하루를 마무리하곤 했다”고 했다. 그러면서 “고단하지 않았다면 거짓말일 것”이라며 “그러나 노동하며 흘린 땀방울로 가족을 지킬 수 있었던 것은 제게 큰 위로이자, 지금의 저를 있게 한 힘이었다”고 했다.)

President Lee said, "I was a child laborer, and I am still proud of that title," adding, "That is why today, when the name has been restored to 'Labor Day' rather than 'Workers' Day,' feels particularly special." He continued, "As the President of South Korea who came from being a child laborer, I will respond to the voices of the workers with a profound sense of mission." (이 대통령은 “저는 소년 노동자였고, 지금도 그 이름이 자랑스럽다”며 “그래서 근로자의 날이 아니라 노동절이라는 제 이름을 찾은 오늘이 더욱 각별하게 다가온다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “소년공 출신 대한민국 대통령으로서 막중한 사명감으로 노동자 여러분의 목소리에 화답하겠다”고 했다.)

Last year, the government amended related laws to change the name from "Workers' Day" to "Labor Day" and designated it as a legal public holiday. This marks 63 years since the law on Workers' Day was first enacted in 1963. (정부는 작년 관련법을 개정해 ‘근로자의 날’ 명칭을 ‘노동절’로 바꾸고 법정 공휴일로 지정했다. 1963년 근로자의 날 관련법이 제정된 지 63년 만이다.)

Attendees at the event included representatives from the Federation of Korean Trade Unions (FKTU) and the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions (KCTU), as well as business leaders such as Sohn Kyung-shik, chairman of the Korea Employers Federation. It was the first time the head of the KCTU attended the government-hosted Labor Day ceremony. President Lee said, "The very fact that labor and management are gathered here together demonstrates the efforts made so far toward respect and coexistence." (이날 행사에는 한국노총과 민주노총, 손경식 한국경영자총협회 회장 등 노동계와 경영계 인사들이 참석했다. 민주노총 위원장이 정부 행사인 노동절 기념식에 참석한 건 처음이다. 이 대통령은 “지금 이 자리에 노동계와 경영계가 함께 하는 것 자체가 존중과 상생을 위한 그간의 노력을 보여주고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jeong Chan-min, Former Lawmaker Who Ran for Yongin City Council, Withdraws Candidacy (용인시의원 도전했던 정찬민 전 국회의원, 출마 철회)
item.description:
Jeong Chan-min, Former Lawmaker Who Ran for Yongin City Council, Withdraws Candidacy (용인시의원 도전했던 정찬민 전 국회의원, 출마 철회)

Jeong Chan-min (68), a former lawmaker from the People Power Party who had been running for a seat on the Yongin City Council in the upcoming June 3 local elections, withdrew his candidacy on the 30th of last month. (오는 6·3 지방선거에서 용인시의회 의원에 도전했던 정찬민(68) 전 국민의힘 의원이 지난달 30일 사퇴했다.)

On the 1st, former lawmaker Jeong posted on his Facebook, "After much deliberation, I withdrew my candidacy registration yesterday and stepped down," adding, "I will help younger colleagues and serve as a foundation for the development of Yongin City." (정 전 의원은 1일 자신의 페이스북에 “저는 숙고 끝에 어제 후보 등록을 철회하고 사퇴했다”며 “앞으로 후배들을 도와 용인시 발전을 위한 밑거름이 되겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Former journalist Jeong underwent an interview as a candidate for the Yongin City Council's Ra district under the People Power Party earlier this month. He was elected as mayor of Yongin in 2014 as a candidate for the Saenuri Party and later won a seat in the 21st National Assembly election in 2020 as a candidate for Yongin-si's Gap district. It is rare for someone who has served as both mayor and lawmaker to run for a basic local council seat. (신문기자 출신인 정 전 의원은 지난달 초 국민의힘의 용인시 라선거구 시의원 후보로 면접을 봤다. 그는 2014년 새누리당 후보로 용인시장에 출마해 당선됐고, 2020년 21대 국회의원 선거 때 용인시갑에 출마해 당선됐다. 시장과 국회의원을 지낸 인물이 기초의원 선거에 나서는 것은 드문 일이다.)

When he launched his bid for city council, former lawmaker Jeong stated, "There are unfinished matters in Yongin, and local figures requested my candidacy." (정 전 의원은 시의원으로 출마하면서 “용인에서 못다 한 일이 있고, 지역 인사들의 출마 요청도 있었다”고 밝혔었다.)

In 2021, allegations emerged that Jeong had provided favors to a real estate development company during his tenure as mayor and received bribes worth approximately 350 million won. He was indicted for this and, in the first trial, sentenced to seven years in prison and a fine of 500 million won. The Supreme Court finalized the ruling in August 2023, but he received a special pardon and restoration of rights last year on Liberation Day. (정 전 의원은 시장 재임 시절 부동산 개발업체의 편의를 봐주고 3억5000만원 상당의 뇌물을 받았다는 의혹이 2021년 불거졌다. 이 일로 기소돼 1심에서 징역 7년에 벌금 5억원을 선고받았다. 2023년 8월 대법원에서 판결이 확정됐으나 지난해 광복절에 특별 사면·복권됐다.)

An aide to former lawmaker Jeong said, "It's true that he decided to withdraw and canceled his candidacy registration," adding, "I understand he had various concerns." (정 전 의원 측 관계자는 “(정 전 의원이) 사퇴하기로 하고 후보 등록도 철회한 것도 맞다”며 “여러 고민이 있었던 것으로 알고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Grants Single Nomination to Lee Jin-sook in Daegu Dalseong... Busan Buk-gu to Hold Primary Between Park Min-sik and Lee Young-pung (국힘, 대구 달성 이진숙 단수 공천... 부산 북갑은 박민식·이영풍 경선)
item.description:
People Power Party Grants Single Nomination to Lee Jin-sook in Daegu Dalseong... Busan Buk-gu to Hold Primary Between Park Min-sik and Lee Young-pung (국힘, 대구 달성 이진숙 단수 공천... 부산 북갑은 박민식·이영풍 경선)

<<>> The People Power Party on the 1st granted single nominations to former Broadcasting and Communications Commission Chairperson Lee Jin-sook and former lawmaker Lee Yong, among others, for the National Assembly by-elections held concurrently with the June 3 local elections. For Busan Buk-gu, where expelled former leader Han Dong-hoon and former Senior Presidential Secretary for AI Future Planning Ha Jung-woo are running, the party decided to hold a primary between former Minister Park Min-sik and former journalist Lee Young-pung. Meanwhile, the nomination for Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, where former Presidential Chief of Staff Chung Jin-suk applied, has been postponed. ()

People Power Party Nomination Management Committee Chairman Park Deok-heum held a press conference that afternoon at the party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, and announced single nominations for the following: former Broadcasting and Communications Commission Chairperson Lee Jin-sook for Daegu Dalseong, Incheon Yeonsu District Party Chairperson Park Jong-jin for Incheon Yeonsu Gap, former lawmaker Lee Yong for Gyeonggi Hanam Gap, former Korea Communications Commission Vice Chairperson Kim Tae-gyu for Ulsan Nam Gap, Environment and Landscape Development Foundation Chairman Shim Wang-seop for Incheon Gyeyang Eul, former Gwangju District Party Chairperson An Tae-wook for Gwangju Gwangsan Eul, and Jeju District Party Chairperson Ko Ki-cheol for Jeju Seogwipo. (국민의힘이 1일 6·3 지방선거와 동시에 치러지는 국회의원 재·보궐선거에 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장과 이용 전 의원 등을 단수 공천했다. 당에서 제명된 한동훈 전 대표와 하정우 전 청와대 AI미래기획수석비서관이 출마하는 부산 북갑은 박민식 전 장관과 이영풍 전 기자 간 경선을 치르기로 했고, 정진석 전 대통령실 비서실장이 공천을 신청한 공주·부여·청양은 공천을 보류하기로 했다.)

For Busan Buk-gu, the People Power Party decided to select its candidate through a primary between former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-sik and former KBS journalist Lee Young-pung. (박덕흠 국민의힘 공천관리위원장은 이날 오후 서울 여의도 국민의힘 당사에서 기자회견을 열고 대구 달성에 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장, 인천 연수갑에 박종진 인천 시당위원장, 경기 하남갑에 이용 전 의원, 울산 남갑에 김태규 전 방송통신위원회 부위원장, 인천 계양을에 심왕섭 환경조경발전재단 이사장, 광주 광산을에 안태욱 전 광주시당위원장, 제주 서귀포에 고기철 제주도당 위원장을 단수 공천한다고 밝혔다.)

Additionally, the nomination for Chungnam Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, applied for by former Chief of Staff Chung Jin-suk, has been postponed with results to be announced on the 7th. Secretary-General Chung Hee-yong stated, "A procedure is underway in accordance with Article 22 of the Ethics Committee regulations." This comes as former Chief Chung has been indicted on charges including failure to appoint Constitutional Court justices, so the review is reportedly focused on assessing his eligibility for candidacy in light of this. (국민의힘은 부산 북갑은 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관과 이영풍 전 KBS 기자 간 경선을 통해 선출하기로 했다.)

According to the current party constitution and regulations of the People Power Party, individuals indicted for certain legal violations are disqualified from running in various internal party primaries and from applying for nominations. However, if deemed to have "substantial reasons such as political oppression," the party leader can, through a decision by the Ethics Committee, cancel or suspend such disciplinary measures. Regarding this, Secretary-General Chung said, "Other candidates (who were indicted but received nominations) were all granted exceptions," adding, "We asked for the Ethics Committee to be convened as quickly as possible." (이밖에 정 전 실장이 공천을 신청한 충남 공주·부여·청양은 공천을 보류하고 오는 7일 발표하기로 했다. 정희용 사무총장은 “윤리위 규정 22조에 따른 절차가 진행 중”이라고 했다. 정 전 실장이 헌법재판관 미임명 등 혐의로 기소된 상황이라 이에 따른 자격 심사에 대한 부분을 심사하는 것으로 전해졌다.)

When asked whether some candidates who completed their nominations that day were so-called "pro-Yoon" candidates close to former President Yoon Suk Yeol, Secretary-General Chung responded, "Decisions were made based on outstanding performance." (현재 국민의힘 당헌·당규에 따르면 일부 법 위반 혐의로 기소된 사람은 당내 각종 경선의 피선거권과 공모 응모 자격이 정지된다. 다만 ‘정치 탄압 등 상당한 이유가 있다고 인정되는 경우’ 당 대표가 윤리위의 의결을 거쳐 징계 처분을 취소 또는 정지할 수 있다. 정 사무총장은 “(기소됐지만 공천을 받은) 다른 후보들은 다 예외를 인정받았다”며 “윤리위를 최대한 빨리 열어달라고 했다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Former Daegu Mayor Moon Hee-gap to Serve as Chairman of Choo Kyung-ho's Campaign Support Committee and Honorary Campaign Chief (문희갑 전 대구시장, 추경호 후원회장·명예선대위원장)
item.description:
Former Daegu Mayor Moon Hee-gap to Serve as Chairman of Choo Kyung-ho's Campaign Support Committee and Honorary Campaign Chief (문희갑 전 대구시장, 추경호 후원회장·명예선대위원장)

Former Daegu Mayor Moon Hee-gap has agreed to serve as both the chairman of the fundraising committee and honorary head of the election campaign for People Power Party’s Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho. Earlier, Moon had served as the fundraising committee chairman for Lee Jin-sook, former chairwoman of the Korea Communications Commission, who had competed against Choo for the party’s nomination for the Daegu mayoral position. (문희갑 전 대구시장이 국민의힘 추경호 대구시장 후보의 후원회장 겸 명예선거대책위원장직을 맡기로 했다. 앞서 문 전 시장은 추 후보와 국민의힘 대구시장 자리를 두고 공천 경쟁을 벌였던 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장의 후원회장을 맡았었다.)

A source from Choo’s campaign said on the 1st, "Former Mayor Moon will simultaneously serve as honorary campaign chief, overseeing the campaign as a general advisor, and fundraising committee chair, lending strong support for victory in this local election." Moon previously served as a senior presidential secretary for economic affairs and as Daegu's first directly elected mayor. During his tenure as Daegu mayor, Moon was credited with significantly lowering urban temperatures and improving citizens' quality of life by spearheading large-scale green projects, including creating urban forests, to mitigate the city’s chronic heatwave issues. (추 후보 캠프 관계자는 “문 전 시장이 캠프의 총괄적 고문 역할인 명예선대위원장과 후원회장을 동시에 맡아 이번 지방선거 승리를 위한 든든한 지원군으로 나선다”고 1일 밝혔다. 문 전 시장은 청와대 경제수석과 민선 초대 대구시장을 지냈다. 대구시장 재임 시절 문 시장은 대구의 고질적인 ‘폭염’ 문제를 완화하기 위해 도심 산림 조성 등 대대적인 녹색사업을 벌여 도심 온도를 낮추고 시민들의 삶의 질을 크게 개선했다는 평가를 받았다.)

Candidate Choo stated, "It is an infinite honor and feels like gaining a thousand-strong army to have Former Mayor Moon, who opened Daegu’s green future, as our fundraising committee chair and honorary campaign chief. Using Mayor Moon’s outstanding administrative philosophy and exceptional economic expertise as a solid foundation, I will surely achieve victory and revitalize Daegu’s stagnant economy." (추 후보는 “대구의 푸른 미래를 열어주신 문 전 시장을 후원회장이자 명예선대위원장으로 모시게 되어 무한한 영광이자 천군만마를 얻은 기분”이라며 “문 시장께서 보여주신 훌륭한 행정 철학과 탁월한 경제적 경륜을 든든한 밑거름 삼아 반드시 승리해 정체된 대구 경제를 반드시 부흥시키겠다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Chu Kyung-ho and Lee Cheol-woo at Park Chung-hee’s Birthplace: "We Will Protect the Heart of Conservatism" (추경호·이철우, 박정희 생가서 “보수 심장 지키겠다”)
item.description:
Chu Kyung-ho and Lee Cheol-woo at Park Chung-hee’s Birthplace: "We Will Protect the Heart of Conservatism" (추경호·이철우, 박정희 생가서 “보수 심장 지키겠다” )

People Power Party's Daegu mayoral preliminary candidate Chu Kyung-ho and North Gyeongsang Province governor preliminary candidate Lee Cheol-woo visited the birthplace of former President Park Chung-hee in Gumi, North Gyeongsang Province, on the 1st, issuing a joint declaration as they rallied conservative forces ahead of the local elections. (국민의힘 추경호 대구시장 예비후보와 이철우 경북지사 예비후보가 1일 경북 구미 박정희 전 대통령 생가를 찾아 공동 선언문을 발표하는 등 지방선거를 앞두고 보수 결집에 나섰다.)

The two preliminary candidates paid their respects together at the memorial hall next to the birthplace that day, then announced a joint declaration for victory in the Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province local elections. The declaration stated: "We will fully inherit President Park Chung-hee's spirit for national development, not resting on past glories, but modernizing that spirit to become a solid cornerstone leading the Republic of Korea's second leap forward. We will dedicate all our capabilities to promote various issues without setbacks, such as the Daegu-North Gyeongsang Province new airport and the push for administrative integration of Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province, through joint cooperation for the development of the region. We will revive the conservative right wing, the pillar of the Republic of Korea, and safeguard liberal democracy." (두 예비후보는 이날 생가 옆 추모관에서 함께 참배한 뒤, 대구·경북 지방선거 승리를 위한 공동 선언문을 발표했다. 이 선언문에는 “박정희 대통령의 국가 발전을 위한 정신을 온전히 계승해 과거의 영광에 머물지 않고, 그 정신을 현대적으로 계승해 대한민국의 제2의 도약을 이끄는 든든한 주춧돌이 되겠다. 대구·경북의 발전을 위해 대구·경북 신공항, 대구·경북 행정 통합 추진 등 다양한 사안을 차질 없이 추진하는 데 모든 역량을 바쳐 공동 협력하겠다. 대한민국의 기둥인 보수 우파를 살리고 자유민주주의를 수호하겠다” 등의 내용이 담겼다.)

Through the joint declaration, they pledged: "Beyond division and conflict, to set straight the Republic of Korea in crisis, the conservative right wing must rise again. From here, Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province—the heart of conservatism—we will spark a wind of innovation and integration, restore public trust through drastic reform, and stand at the forefront to protect the true values of the conservative right wing and the Republic of Korea." (이들은 공동 선언문을 통해 “분열과 갈등을 넘어, 위기에 처한 대한민국을 바로 세우기 위해서는 보수 우파가 다시 일어서야 한다”며 “보수의 심장인 이곳 대구·경북에서부터 혁신과 통합의 바람을 일으키고, 뼈를 깎는 쇄신으로 국민의 신뢰를 회복하고, 보수 우파의 진정한 가치와 대한민국을 지켜내는 최선봉에 서겠다”고 약속했다.)

In a subsequent press conference, the two preliminary candidates said in unison: "Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province are one shared destiny, and when we join forces, the region's future opens up." (이후 진행한 기자간담회를 통해 두 예비 후보는 “대구와 경북은 하나의 공동 운명체이며 힘을 모을 때 지역의 미래가 열린다”고 입을 모았다.)

Preliminary candidate Chu stated: "Daegu is now at a point where a great transition is needed—not mere improvement but a change in the structure itself. Through industrial structure innovation, we will transform the economic foundation and create a city where young people return." Preliminary candidate Lee said: "Just as we defended our country during the Korean War, this time too, Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province must take the lead. I make a vow to President Park Chung-hee: we will surely protect liberal democracy and the values of conservatism." (추 예비 후보는 “지금 대구는 단순한 개선이 아닌 구조 자체를 바꾸는 대전환이 필요한 시점”이라며 “산업 구조 혁신을 통해 경제 체질을 바꾸고 청년이 돌아오는 도시를 만들겠다”고 밝혔다. 이 예비 후보는 “6·25 전쟁 당시 우리가 나라를 지켜냈듯 이번에도 대구·경북이 중심이 돼야 한다. 박정희 대통령께 다짐을 드리고 자유민주주의와 보수의 가치를 반드시 지켜내겠다”고 말했다.)

The event was attended by about 500 people, including National Assembly member Gu Ja-geun, Gumi mayoral preliminary candidate Kim Jang-ho, other party lawmakers, local government head candidates, and supporters. (이날 행사에는 구자근 국회의원, 김장호 구미시장 예비후보 등 같은 당 국회의원과 기초단체장 후보, 지지자 등 500여 명이 참석했다.)

item.title: Justice Party: "Opposing the Ruling Party’s Special Counsel Bill Paving the Way for Dropping Charges… Undermining Separation of Powers" (정의당 “공소 취소 길 내는 與 특검법 반대…권력 분립 훼손”)
item.description:
Justice Party: "Opposing the Ruling Party’s Special Counsel Bill Paving the Way for Dropping Charges… Undermining Separation of Powers" (정의당 “공소 취소 길 내는 與 특검법 반대…권력 분립 훼손”)

The Justice Party stated on the 1st regarding the "Special Counsel Bill to Investigate the Truth Behind the Yoon Suk Yeol Administration’s Manipulated Indictments," proposed by the Democratic Party of Korea the previous day, "We oppose the special counsel bill that paves the way for dropping charges" and "We can never agree to such a law." (정의당은 1일 더불어민주당이 전날 발의한 ‘윤석열 정권 조작기소 진상규명 특검법’에 대해 “‘공소 취소’ 길 내는 조작기소 특검법을 반대한다”며 “이런 법에 결코 동의할 수 없다”고 했다.)

In a statement released the same day, the Justice Party said, "Although it is named after the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, the majority of cases under investigation are directly or indirectly related to President Lee Jae-myung. This law grants the special counsel the authority to maintain prosecutions for these cases, effectively opening the door to dropping charges." (정의당은 이날 성명에서 “윤석열 정권이라고 이름 붙였지만, 수사 대상 사건은 이재명 대통령과 직간접적으로 관련된 것이 대부분이다. 이 법은 해당 사건들의 공소 유지 권한을 특검에 부여해 사실상 공소 취소의 길을 열었다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

The Justice Party noted, "The cases for which President Lee has been indicted are all currently suspended due to immunity from prosecution," adding, "In this context, the Democratic Party has leveraged its overwhelming approval ratings and parliamentary seats to propose a special counsel bill that essentially aims to drop charges." It further stated, "This special counsel bill could spark significant controversy regarding the principle of separation of powers." (정의당은 “이 대통령이 기소된 사건들은 불소추특권에 따라 모두 재판이 중단된 상태”라며 “이런 상황에서 민주당의 압도적인 지지율과 의석수를 활용해 사실상 공소 취소를 위한 특검법을 발의한 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “이 특검법은 권력분립 원칙에 있어 매우 큰 논란을 일으킬 수 있다”고 했다.)

The Justice Party explained, "President Lee will appoint one of the special counsel candidates recommended by the Democratic Party, the People Power Party, and the Rebuilding Korea Party," adding, "This means he will appoint a special counsel with the authority to drop charges in his own case. It is a process that cannot avoid controversy." (정의당은 “민주당·국민의힘·조국혁신당에서 추천한 특검 후보 중 한 명을 이 대통령이 임명하게 된다”며 “본인 사건의 공소 취소 권한을 지니는 특검을 본인이 임명하는 꼴이다. 논란을 피할 수 없는 절차”라고 했다.)

It continued, "Formally, the head of the executive branch is directly deciding whether judicial procedures continue, which undermines the most fundamental principle of separation of powers in the constitutional order," and pointed out, "Moreover, the bill even includes cases such as Seongnam FC, Baekhyeon-dong, and the Public Official Election Act, which were not part of the current parliamentary investigation, and this will also impose a massive political burden on the president." (이어 “형식상 행정부 수장이 사법 절차의 존속 여부를 직접 결정하는 것인데, 헌정질서의 가장 기본적인 권력 분립 원칙을 훼손하는 일”이라며 “심지어 해당 법안에는 이번 국정조사에는 포함도 되지 않았던 성남FC·백현동·공직선거법 사건까지 포함됐다는 점에서 대통령에게도 막대한 정치적 부담으로 돌아오게 될 것”이라고 지적했다.)

The Justice Party said, "We are wary of such a precedent, where legislative power abuses the special counsel bill to shield the president and disrupts judicial procedures," asking, "If the People Power Party exploits this precedent to arbitrarily wield the authority to drop charges, how and on what grounds could it be stopped?" (정의당은 “이처럼 입법권력이 대통령 엄호의 목적으로 특검법을 남용하고 사법 절차를 뒤흔드는 선례를 경계한다”며 “국민의힘이 이 선례를 악용해 공소 취소 권한을 제멋대로 휘두른다면 무슨 수로, 무슨 명분으로 막을 수 있겠느냐”고 했다.)

It added, "The Democratic Party must immediately stop these overreaching actions and prove the president’s innocence through judicial procedures." (그러면서 “민주당은 무리수를 즉각 중단하고 사법 절차에 따라 이 대통령의 무죄를 증명하라”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Moon-soo, Revived by Jang Dong-hyuk... Appointed as Election Committee Chair in Eight Regions (장동혁이 부활시킨 김문수... 8곳서 선대위원장 맡았다)
item.description:
Kim Moon-soo, Revived by Jang Dong-hyuk... Appointed as Election Committee Chair in Eight Regions (장동혁이 부활시킨 김문수... 8곳서 선대위원장 맡았다)

Kim Moon-soo, former Minister of Employment and Labor of the People Power Party, was appointed on the 1st as the standing election committee chair for the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul (District B) by-election for the National Assembly. This by-election, contested in a five-way race, is considered a battleground where no one can confidently guarantee victory. Additionally, the former minister Kim also holds honorary election committee chair positions in seven other regions for the June 3 local elections, including Busan, Daegu, Incheon, Ulsan, Sejong, Gangwon, and North Gyeongsang. (국민의힘 김문수 전 고용노동부 장관이 경기 평택을(乙) 국회의원 재선거의 상임 선거대책위원장으로 1일 위촉됐다. ‘5자 구도’로 치러지는 평택을 국회의원 재선거는 누구도 승리를 장담하기 어려운 접전지로 분류되는 곳이다. 이 밖에도 김 전 장관은 6·3 지방선거의 부산·대구·인천·울산·세종·강원·경북 등 7개 지역의 명예 선대위원장도 겸직하고 있다.)

Yoo Ui-dong, the People Power Party candidate for Pyeongtaek-eul, said on the same day, "In the complex structure of the Pyeongtaek-eul election, the consolidation of conservatives is the biggest variable," adding, "I asked former Minister Kim to take on that role." Former Minister Kim also stated in a phone call with this newspaper, "At every critical juncture of the election, I will personally go to the Pyeongtaek site to appeal to voters for support for candidate Yoo Ui-dong," and "With the resolve to protect the lifeline of conservatism, I will work hard across all eight provinces of the country." <<> Five candidates have so far entered the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election, which was triggered after Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Byeong-jin received a sentence that invalidated his election. The Democratic Party nominated former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam, who moved from the People Power Party to the Reform Party and then joined the Democratic Party last year. The People Power Party is fielding Yoo Ui-dong, a three-term lawmaker from Pyeongtaek. In Pyeongtaek-eul, Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party; Kim Jae-yeon, standing leader of the Progressive Party; and Hwang Kyo-ahn, leader of the Liberty and Innovation Party, have also entered the race. <<> In a poll commissioned by Pressian and conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) on the 25th and 26th, candidate Cho Kuk received 23.4%, candidate Kim Yong-nam 21.4%, and candidate Yoo Ui-dong 21.2%. All three are in a tight race within the margin of error (±3.7 percentage points). Candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn received 12%, and candidate Kim Jae-yeon received 9.4% support. Former Minister Kim, appointed as the standing election committee chair for Pyeongtaek-eul of the People Power Party, is expected to campaign primarily in areas where candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn is strong. <<> Within and outside the party, a role for Kim Moon-soo is emerging, centered on the Yeongnam region. This contrasts with Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, who faces calls to step down amid controversies over lies about a U.S. visit and declining party approval ratings. In the party leadership election last August, Representative Jang defeated former Minister Kim, but within just eight months, their positions have reversed. It is known that Representative Jang was not even invited to the campaign kick-off events held by the Gangwon and Seoul party chapters. <<> Regarding the growing calls for his resignation, particularly from local election candidate groups, Representative Jang stated, "Stepping down as party leader because the situation is bad is not responsible politics." In response to a question about Representative Jang's position on MBC Radio on the 27th of last month, Jang Ye-chan, a former deputy director of the Yeouido Research Institute and a close aide, said, "After the election, might we not need a vote by all party members?" This is interpreted as an indication of Representative Jang's unwillingness to step down, regardless of the local election results. (국민의힘 유의동 평택을 후보는 이날 “복잡한 구도의 평택을 선거에서는 보수 결집이 최대 변수”라며 “김문수 전 장관께 그 역할을 부탁드렸다”고 말했다. 김 전 장관도 본지 통화에서 “선거의 고비마다 직접 평택 현장에서 유의동 후보의 지지를 유권자들에게 호소할 것”이라며 “보수의 명맥(命脈)만큼은 지켜야 한다는 각오로 전국 팔도 곳곳에서 열심히 뛰겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: In People Power Party's Busan Buk-gu A District Interview: “Will You Unite with Han?”... Candidates Say “No” (국힘 북갑 면접서 “韓과 단일화 할거냐” 압박...후보들 “안 한다”)
item.description:
In People Power Party's Busan Buk-gu A District Interview: “Will You Unite with Han?”... Candidates Say “No” (국힘 북갑 면접서 “韓과 단일화 할거냐” 압박...후보들 “안 한다”)

The People Power Party's nomination management committee reportedly focused on asking applicants for the Busan Buk-gu A district during interviews on the 1st about whether they would unite with independent former leader Han Dong-hoon. The by-election for Busan Buk-gu A, which is occurring due to Democratic Party lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo's run for Busan mayor, is expected to be a three-way race among the People Power Party candidate, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, and independent former leader Han. (국민의힘 공천관리위원회가 1일 부산 북갑 공천 신청자 면접에서 무소속 한동훈 전 대표와의 단일화 여부를 집중적으로 물은 것으로 전해졌다. 전재수 더불어민주당 의원의 부산시장 출마로 인해 보궐선거가 치러지는 부산 북갑은 국민의힘 후보와 민주당 하정우 후보, 무소속 한 전 대표의 3파전으로 치러질 전망이다.)

On that day, former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-sik and former KBS reporter Lee Young-pung met with reporters immediately after their Busan Buk-gu A nomination interviews and stated, “We received questions about unification.” (이날 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관과 이영풍 전 KBS 기자는 부산 북갑 공천 면접을 치른 직후 기자들과 만나 “단일화에 대한 질문을 받았다”고 말했다.)

Former Minister Park said, “I was asked in the interview about my thoughts on unification, and I replied that even if the party leadership tried to force unification, I would not comply,” adding, “I am so firm on unification that there's no need to discuss it further.” (박 전 장관은 “면접에서 단일화에 대한 생각을 질문으로 받았고 당 지도부에서 혹여 단일화를 강요한다 해도 따르지 않을 것이라고 답했다”며 “단일화에 대해서는 더 이상 이야기할 필요가 없을 정도로 확고부동하다”고 했다.)

Former reporter Lee also said, “The first question was, ‘Aren't you going to unify with former Representative Han, who is running as an independent?’” adding, “It seems the nomination committee members are most worried about that.” He said, “Personally, I said, ‘Let's write a pledge today that I won't unify.’ I will not unify.” (이 전 기자도 “첫 질문이 ‘(무소속으로 나오는 한 전 대표와) 단일화하는 것 아니냐’였다”며 “공관위원들이 제일 걱정하는 것 같다”고 했다. 그는 “저는 개인적으로 ‘오늘 (단일화하지 않겠다고) 각서 씁시다’라고 했다. 저는 단일화하지 않을 것”이라고 말했다.)

The People Power Party has decided to select the final candidate through a primary between former Minister Park and former reporter Lee. The winner will be determined on the 5th by combining a vote of responsible party members (50%) and a general public opinion poll (50%) over two days, the 3rd and 4th. (국민의힘은 박 전 장관과 이 전 기자 간 경선을 통해 최종 후보를 선출하기로 했다. 3~4일 양일간 책임당원 투표(50%)와 일반 국민 여론조사(50%)를 합산해 5일 승자를 가린다.)

Meanwhile, former Representative Han will register as a preliminary candidate on the 4th. In a Facebook post that day, Han stated, “I will register as a preliminary candidate for the Busan Buk-gu A National Assembly seat on the 4th, hold an open declaration press conference on the afternoon of the 9th, and officially open my election office on the 10th.” (한편 한 전 대표는 4일 예비후보로 등록한다. 한 전 대표는 이날 페이스북에 글을 올려 “4일 부산 북갑 국회의원 예비후보로 등록하고, 9일 오후에는 공개 출마 선언 기자회견, 10일에는 선거사무소 공식 개소식을 할 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: North Korean Defectors Testify with Tears Before U.S. Congress: "Lived a Life Worse Than a Dog in North Korea" (탈북민들, 미국 의회서 눈물의 증언 “북한서 개보다도 못한 인생 살았다”)
item.description:
"My late grandfather often said, 'The Kim regime is the greatest con artist in history.' It was only after I accidentally heard a radio broadcast that I realized he was right." On the 29th of last month, at the Rayburn House Office Building on Capitol Hill in Washington, D.C., Yang Il-cheol, who defected through the Demilitarized Zone last year, spoke calmly but firmly about his experiences. According to VOA, Yang's grandfather was a diplomat who served as North Korea's ambassador to Equatorial Guinea in Africa. He said he initially doubted his grandfather's dangerous remarks about the outside world, but after listening to radio broadcasts sent by free-world countries for North Korean residents starting in 2018, he came to understand the true nature of North Korea and empathized with his grandfather's feelings. <<> Last December, Yang, who became a citizen of the Republic of Korea, along with 11 other North Korean defectors who escaped the oppression of the North Korean regime, attended a forum hosted by Republican Representative Young Kim and shared their experiences. Kim, who is of Korean descent, chairs the House Foreign Affairs Subcommittee on East Asia and the Pacific. The participants shared their personal stories and emphasized the need for information inflow. <<> Lee Jae-hee, who defected in 2018, said he lost his entire family to starvation when he was 12 years old. Having endured eight years of harsh labor in the North Korean forced labor organization known as the Youth Shock Brigade, he said that after watching Korean dramas in China, he "realized I had lived a life worse than a dog in North Korea." Lee Sun-sil, who was forcibly repatriated multiple times from China between 1997 and 2007, suffered human trafficking and still does not know the fate of her daughter. She testified that while crossing the Yalu River with her three-year-old daughter during her defection, "my daughter was sold for $150." A congressional official described the atmosphere, saying, "Several defectors kept shedding tears during their testimony, bringing a somber hush over the meeting room." <<> On the 30th, the defectors also testified behind closed doors in the Senate. Representative Kim stated, "Kim Jong Un cares only about power, filling his own pockets at the expense of his own people, and is hell-bent on expanding nuclear weapons," adding, "Severe human rights abuses against the people cannot be tolerated." This forum was held as part of the annual "North Korean Human Rights Week," aimed at raising awareness in U.S. political circles about the need to promote the human rights and dignity of North Korean residents. <<> On the 28th, a North Korean human rights hearing hosted by the bipartisan congressional human rights group, the Tom Lantos Human Rights Commission, took place, where attendees criticized the South Korean government under President Lee Jae-myung for its conciliatory policies toward the North, such as suspending broadcasts into North Korea. Suzanne Scholte, a North Korean human rights activist known as the "Godmother of North Korean Defectors" and president of the Defense Forum Foundation, said, "The South Korean government is abandoning its constitutional duties regarding North Korean human rights and information inflow activities, marking the most challenging period in the history of North Korean human rights activism." (“돌아가신 할아버지는 생전에 ‘김씨 정권이 역사상 가장 위대한 사기꾼’이라는 말을 많이 하셨어요. 우연히 라디오를 듣고 나서야 할아버지 말씀이 옳다는 걸 알게 됐죠.” 지난달 29일 미국 워싱턴 DC 연방 의회 레이번 하원 의원회관. 지난해 비무장지대를 통해 탈북한 양일철씨가 차분하지만 단호한 어조로 자신의 경험을 얘기했다. VOA(미국의 소리)에 따르면 양씨의 할아버지는 아프리카 적도기니 주재 북한 대사를 지낸 외교관이다. 바깥세상을 경험한 할아버지의 위험천만한 발언을 처음에는 반신반의했는데 2018년부터 북한 주민들을 위해 자유 진영 국가들이 송출하는 라디오 방송을 들으면서 북한의 실체를 알게 돼 할아버지 심정에 공감하게 됐다는 얘기다.)

item.title: Cho Kook Digs Up Past, Kim Yong-nam Refuses to Respond (과거 캐묻는 조국, 맞대응 않는 김용남)
item.description:
A war of nerves is escalating between Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate in the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election for the National Assembly, and Cho Kook, the candidate for the Cho Kook Innovation Party. Candidate Cho has been demanding explanations almost daily, citing past remarks made by Kim, who came from conservative parties such as the Saenuri Party. Candidate Kim has labeled this a "negative campaign" and stated he will not respond. The Pyeongtaek-eul election is shaping up as a five-way race, including candidates Kim and Cho, along with Yoo Eui-dong of the People Power Party, Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party, and Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Liberty and Innovation Party. <<> On the 1st, Park Byeong-eon, spokesperson for Candidate Cho’s camp, stated in a commentary, "Candidate Kim must answer whether he is qualified to represent the Democratic Party." Spokesperson Park demanded an apology, noting that when Kim was a member of the People Power Party, he 'defended' the Park Geun-hye administration's agreement on the Japan-Korea comfort women issue and described the activities of the Sewol Ferry Special Investigation Committee as a 'waste of tax money.' Candidate Cho also argued on a radio program the previous day, "Candidate Kim used extreme language about the Sewol Ferry disaster during his People Power Party days, causing pain to the victims," adding, "Public scrutiny is necessary." Additionally, Candidate Cho’s camp has taken issue with Kim’s past strong criticism of Cho, earning him the nickname 'Cho Kook sniper.' <<> In response, Candidate Kim appeared on YouTube that day and stated, "I will generally not respond," adding, "If someone makes false claims, I will only explain the truth to voters, but I won’t do anything else." The previous day, he also said, "This election should be a policy and vision contest for Pyeongtaek, but constantly digging up (the past) turns it into a negative mudslinging battle." <<> Regarding the power struggle between the two candidates, some within the ruling party interpret it as "a war of nerves ahead of a possible unification among the pan-opposition forces." The Democratic Party and the Cho Kook Innovation Party officially insist, "Our candidate can win even without unification." However, there are forecasts that if the conservative camp, including the People Power Party, moves toward unification, the opposition forces will inevitably have to unite as well. Kim Jae-yeon, the Progressive Party candidate, also reiterated a call for unification discussions with the Democratic Party and the Cho Kook Innovation Party that day. (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 출마한 김용남 더불어민주당 후보와 조국 조국혁신당 후보 간에 신경전이 이어지고 있다. 조 후보는 새누리당 등 보수 정당 출신인 김 후보의 과거 발언을 거론하며 연일 해명을 요구하고 있다. 김 후보는 이를 ‘네거티브’라고 규정하면서 대응하지 않겠다고 했다. 평택을 선거는 김, 조 후보를 비롯해 국민의힘 유의동, 진보당 김재연, 자유와혁신 황교안 후보 등 5자 구도로 치러지고 있다.)

item.title: "Park Wan-soo Created a Minus in South Gyeongsang, I Will Revive It" (“박완수가 마이너스 만든 경남, 다시 살릴 것”)
item.description:
Kim Kyoung-soo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for South Gyeongsang Province governor, said in an interview with this newspaper on the 29th about incumbent Governor Park Wan-soo's four-year administration, "Last year, the South Korean economy grew by 1% positive, but South Gyeongsang alone experienced a 0.8% negative growth," adding, "This is the result of staying 'adequately managed' without innovation." Candidate Kim was first elected as South Gyeongsang governor in 2018 as a member of a Democratic Party-affiliated party and is now seeking to reclaim the position against Governor Park, who is running for re-election in the June 3 local elections. (더불어민주당 김경수 경남도지사 후보는 지난 29일 본지 인터뷰에서 박완수 현 지사의 4년 도정에 대해 “작년 대한민국 경제가 1% 플러스 성장을 했는데, 경남만 홀로 0.8% 마이너스 성장을 했다”며 “혁신 없이 ‘무난한 관리’에만 머문 결과”라고 했다. 김 후보는 2018년 지방선거 때 민주당 계열 정당 소속으로는 처음으로 경남지사에 당선됐고, 이번 6·3 지방선거에서 연임 도전에 나서는 박 지사를 상대로 탈환을 노리고 있다.)

Candidate Kim stated, "Governor Park fails to grasp the policy direction of the Lee Jae-myung administration and repeatedly introduces 'offbeat' policies," adding, "South Gyeongsang needs a governor who is a 'perfect match' to align with the Lee Jae-myung administration's regional revitalization policies." He further said, "Governor Park scrapped the 'Megacity' project linking Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang, costing 35 trillion won," and vowed, "I will restore the Megacity policy immediately upon election to revive South Gyeongsang." (김 후보는 “박 지사가 이재명 정부의 정책 흐름을 읽지 못하고 반복해서 ‘엇박자’ 정책을 내고 있다”며 “경남엔 이재명 정부의 지방 살리기 정책과 호흡을 맞출 ‘찰떡궁합’ 도지사가 필요하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “부산·울산·경남을 묶는 ‘메가시티’를 박 지사가 백지화해 35조원이 날아갔다”며 “당선되는 즉시 메가시티 정책을 복원해 경남을 살리겠다”고 했다.)

-The approval rating gap between ruling and opposition candidates in the Yeongnam region is narrowing. (-영남권의 여야 후보 간 지지율 격차가 좁혀지고 있다.)

"Current opinion polls are not very important. Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang have always been difficult regions for the Democratic Party. Even if opinion polls show a lead of over 10 percentage points, it's a place where things can quickly turn around if incidents occur. So it's a region where we can't let our guard down until the very end. While approval ratings for Democratic Party candidates look good nationally in polls, we shouldn't get intoxicated by the numbers. We will run a humble campaign without negativity, focusing on people's livelihoods until the end." (“지금 여론조사는 크게 중요하지 않다. 부·울·경은 민주당에 늘 어려운 지역이다. 아무리 여론조사가 10%포인트 이상 앞선다고 하더라도 이런저런 사건이 생기면 금방 바람이 불면서 뒤집어지는 곳이다. 그래서 마지막까지 안심할 수 없는 곳, 긴장을 늦출 수 없는 곳이다. 민주당 후보들의 지지율이 여론조사로 보면 전국적으로 잘 나오지만, 숫자에 취하면 안 된다. 네거티브없이 겸손하게, 민생을 끝까지 챙기는 선거전을 펼치겠다.")

-Why did you decide to run for South Gyeongsang governor again? (-왜 경남지사에 다시 도전했나.)

"The core of this election is the 'crisis of South Gyeongsang's economy.' When the entire Republic of Korea was growing, only South Gyeongsang fell backward. This election is about who will overcome this crisis, especially who is the best fit to communicate with the Lee Jae-myung administration, which is going 'all-in' on regional revitalization. Governor Park has managed things adequately, as expected from an administrative bureaucrat. But South Gyeongsang falls into crisis when merely managed adequately. In that regard, I, who served as the chairman of the current administration's Presidential Committee for Regional Development, am the right person." (“이번 선거 핵심은 ‘경남 경제의 위기’다. 대한민국 전체가 성장할 때 경남만 거꾸로 추락했다. 이 위기를 누가 극복할 것인가, 특히 지방 살리기에 ‘올인’하는 이재명 정부와 누가 가장 잘 소통할 적임자인가를 찾는 선거다. 박 지사는 행정 관료 출신답게 무난하게 관리해왔다. 하지만 경남은 무난하게 관리만 하면 위기에 빠진다. 그런면에서 현 정부 지방시대위원회 위원장을 지낸 내가 적임자다.”)

-Governor Park recently pointed out in an interview with this newspaper that "South Gyeongsang's debt increased during Candidate Kim's tenure as governor." (-박 지사가 최근 본지 인터뷰에서 “김 후보의 지사 시절 경남의 빚이 늘었다”고 지적했는데.)

"When I took office as governor in 2018, South Gyeongsang's economy was in negative territory. So I attracted numerous national projects. That includes the 1.6 trillion won smart industrial complex project. How could that be done without incurring debt? We did take on debt, but the finances were managed very stably. Right after I left office in 2022, South Gyeongsang's debt-to-budget ratio was 9.4%, the lowest in the country." (“2018년에 지사로 취임했을 때 경남 경제가 마이너스였다. 그래서 각종 국책사업들을 대거 유치했다. 1조 6000억원짜리 스마트산단 프로젝트 등이 그것이다. 빚을 내지 않고 그걸 어떻게 하나. 빚을 내긴 했지만 재정은 매우 안정적으로 관리됐다. 제가 도정을 그만둔 직후인 2022년 경남의 예산 대비 채무 비율은 9.4%로 전국 최저 수준이었다.”)

-What is the local mood like? (-지역 분위기는 어떤가.)

"I hear a lot of people say, 'It's really hard to make a living.' When I visit markets, merchants often say, 'We're struggling just to compete for a living, please stop the political squabbling.' Isn't President Lee Jae-myung the one best addressing livelihood issues right now? They want local governments to do the same. They want local administrations to act with the same speed as the Lee Jae-myung administration." (“‘진짜로 먹고 살기 힘들다’는 얘기를 많이 하신다. 시장을 가보면 상인분들이 ‘먹고 사는 문제로 경쟁 해도 시원찮을 판에, 아이고 제발 정치 싸움 좀 고마해라’라는 얘기를 제일 많이 듣고 있다. 먹고 사는 문제를 해결해 나가는 데 지금 제일 잘하고 있는 사람이 이재명 대통령 아닌가. 지방정부도 그렇게 해달라는 거다. 지방 정부도 이재명 정부처럼 속도감 있는 행정을 하라는 것이다.”)

-You've pledged to restore the 'Busan, Ulsan, South Gyeongsang Megacity.' (―‘부산·울산·경남 메가시티’ 복원을 공약으로 내세웠는데.)

"The Busan-Ulsan-South Gyeongsang Megacity was a project I pushed during the Moon Jae-in administration. It was a project that secured a 35 trillion won budget commitment from the central government. But Governor Park Wan-soo abruptly dismantled it after taking office, calling it a 'superfluous structure.' The Megacity is a project that requires consultation and agreement among local governments. With the government subsidies gone, it was only natural for South Gyeongsang's economy to plunge into negative territory. We need to restore the Megacity to create growth engines to counter the 'single-pole system' of the Seoul metropolitan area." (“부·울·경 메가시티는 문재인 정부 당시 내가 추진했다. 중앙 정부로부터 35조원의 예산 지원을 약속받았던 프로젝트다. 그런데 박완수 지사가 취임 후 ‘옥상옥’이라며 대뜸 해체해버렸다. 메가시티는 지자체들끼리 협의·합의를 이뤄내야 하는 사업이다. 정부 지원금이 사라졌으니 경남 경제가 마이너스로 추락하는 건 당연한 결과다. 메가시티 복원을 통해 수도권 ‘일극 체제’에 맞설 성장 동력을 다시 만들어야 한다.”)

-Governor Park's side argues for an 'administrative integration' of Busan and South Gyeongsang as an alternative, claiming the Megacity is redundant. (―박 지사 측은 메가시티가 옥상옥이라면서 대안으로 부산·경남 ‘행정통합’을 주장한다.)

"This time, South Gyeongsang failed to achieve administrative integration, making it possible only after the general election at the earliest, two years from now. So will we just twiddle our thumbs for two years? The central government is asking us to form some kind of regional alliance at the pre-integration stage and push joint projects first. That's the only way to secure budget. Who can oppose receiving budget?" (“이번에 경남이 행정통합을 하지 못하면서 빨라도 2년 뒤 총선 때나 가능해졌다. 그럼 2년 동안은 손가락만 빨고 있을 건가. 행정통합 전 단계에서 권역별로 연합체 형태라도 만들어 공동 사업을 먼저 추진하자는 게 중앙 정부 주문이다. 그래야 예산을 받아올 수 있다. 예산 받자는 데 누가 반대할 수 있나.”)

-What is your plan to turn South Gyeongsang's economy from negative to positive? (―마이너스였던 경남 경제를 플러스로 돌려놓을 방안은 뭔가.)

"I am someone who jointly designed regional development policies as chairman of the Lee Jae-myung administration's Presidential Committee for Regional Development. I have a 'perfect match' with President Lee. When I took office as governor in 2018, I turned the then-negative economy positive by attracting central government support. I believe the residents will wisely judge who can revive South Gyeongsang's economy, which Governor Park Wan-soo has once again turned negative." (“나는 이재명 정부의 지방시대위원장으로 지방 발전 정책을 함께 설계한 사람이다. 이 대통령과는 ‘찰떡궁합’이다. 2018년 도지사 취임 당시 마이너스였던 경제를 중앙정부 지원을 끌어와 플러스로 돌려세웠었다. 박완수 지사가 또 다시 마이너스로 만든 경남 경제, 누가 다시 살릴 수 있는지 도민들께서 현명하게 판단해 주실 것이라 믿는다.”)

-There are calls for unity within the broader opposition. (-범여권 단일화를 요구 중이다.)

"From the insurrection to the impeachment, the 'Revolution of Light' process saw the Progressive Party also join forces to achieve a change of government. Therefore, we are making unification efforts through various channels, including discussions at the central party and civil society levels." (“내란 이후 탄핵에 이르기까지 ‘빛의 혁명’ 과정에서 진보당도 힘을 모아서 정권교체를 이뤘다. 그렇기에 중앙당, 시민사회 차원의 논의를 포함해 다양한 경로로 단일화 노력을 하고 있다.”)

-You did not complete your term as South Gyeongsang governor due to the 'Druking incident.' (―경남지사 시절 드루킹 사건으로 임기를 마치지 못했다.)

"I have repeatedly expressed my deep regret and apology to the residents whenever I had the chance. I once again sincerely apologize to the residents for not completing my term. I feel a heavy sense of responsibility seeing the large-scale national projects I initiated, such as the Western and South Gyeongsang KTX, being delayed or the Megacity project being scrapped. With a sense of 'whoever made the mistake should fix it,' I will do all I can to revitalize the region for the remainder of my career." (“지금까지 기회가 있을 때마다 도민들께 정말 송구하고 죄송하다고 해왔다. 도정을 끝까지 마무리하지 못한 점은 도민들께 다시 한 번 깊이 사과드린다. 제가 시작한 서부·경남 KTX 등 대형 국책 사업들이 지연되거나 메가시티 사업이 폐기되는 것을 보며 무거운 책임감을 느꼈다. 결자해지의 마음으로 지역을 살리는 데 남은 모든 역할을 다하겠다.”)

☞Who is Kim Kyoung-soo (☞김경수는 누구)

Native of Goseong, South Gyeongsang, he graduated from Jinju Dongmyeong High School and Seoul National University's Department of Anthropology. He served as a presidential secretary in the Roh Moo-hyun administration and after Roh's retirement, moved to Bongha Village in Gimhae, South Gyeongsang, earning the title 'Roh Moo-hyun's last secretary.' He was a key aide to former President Moon Jae-in. He was elected in Gimhae during the 2016 general election and as South Gyeongsang governor in the 2018 local elections. He lost the governorship due to the 'Druking incident' but was pardoned and reinstated during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration. He served as chairman of the Presidential Committee for Regional Development under President Lee Jae-myung. (경남 고성 출신으로 진주 동명고와 서울대 인류학과를 졸업했다. 노무현 정부 청와대 비서관을 지냈고 노 전 대통령 퇴임 후 경남 김해 봉하마을로 내려가 ‘노무현의 마지막 비서관’으로 불렸다. 문재인 전 대통령의 핵심 참모였다. 2016년 총선 때 김해에서 당선됐고 2018년 지방선거 때 경남지사에 당선됐다. ‘드루킹 사건’으로 지사직을 잃었다가 윤석열 정부 때 사면·복권됐다. 이재명 대통령 직속 지방시대위원회 위원장을 지냈다.)

item.title: People Power Party's By-Election Nominations Largely Favor Pro-Yoon Figures (국힘 재보선 공천, 줄줄이 친윤)
item.description:
On the 1st, ahead of the June 3 local elections and concurrent National Assembly by-elections, the People Power Party (PPP) unilaterally nominated former Broadcasting and Communications Commission Chairperson Lee Jin-sook for Daegu Dalseong. Additionally, former lawmaker Lee Yong was nominated for Gyeonggi Hanam-gap, and Park Jong-jin, chairman of the Incheon city party committee, for Incheon Yeonsu-gap. They will face Democratic Party of Korea candidate Lee Gwang-jae, a former Gangwon Province governor, and Song Young-gil, a former Incheon mayor, respectively. (국민의힘이 1일 6·3 지방선거와 동시에 치러지는 국회의원 재·보궐선거를 앞두고 대구 달성에 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장을 단수 공천했다. 또한 경기 하남갑에는 이용 전 의원, 인천 연수갑에는 박종진 인천 시당위원장을 공천했다. 각각 강원지사를 지낸 더불어민주당 이광재 후보, 인천시장을 지낸 민주당 송영길 후보와 맞붙는다.)

In addition, the PPP unilaterally nominated former Broadcasting and Communications Commission Vice Chairperson Kim Tae-gyu for Ulsan Nam-gap, Shim Wang-seop, chairman of the Environmental Landscape Development Foundation, for Incheon Gyeyang-eul, Ahn Tae-wook, a former chairman of the Gwangju city party committee, for Gwangju Gwangsan-eul, and Ko Ki-cheol, a former chairman of the Jeju provincial party committee, for Jeju Seogwipo. (이와함께 국민의힘은 울산 남갑에 김태규 전 방송통신위원회 부위원장, 인천 계양을에 심왕섭 환경조경발전재단 이사장, 광주 광산을에 안태욱 전 광주시당위원장, 제주 서귀포에 고기철 전 제주도당 위원장을 각각 단수 공천했다.)

For Busan Buk-gap, the party decided to hold a primary between former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-sik and former KBS journalist Lee Young-pung. The primary will take place over two days, on the 3rd and 4th, with the final candidate announced on the 5th. In Buk-gap, former Blue House Senior Secretary for AI Future Planning Ha Jeong-woo is running as the Democratic Party candidate, while former PPP leader Han Dong-hoon, who was expelled from the party, is running as an independent. (부산 북갑에는 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관과 이영풍 전 KBS 기자 간 경선을 치르기로 했다. 3~4일 양일 간 경선을 통해 5일 최종 후보를 발표한다. 북갑에는 하정우 전 청와대 AI미래기획수석비서관이 민주당 후보로, 국민의힘에서 제명된 한동훈 전 대표가 무소속으로 출마한 상태다.)

The PPP stated on the day, "We selected candidates with outstanding performance in interviews and other assessments," but concerns arose from within the party as numerous figures from the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, including candidates Lee Jin-sook and Lee Tae-gyu, received nominations. In particular, with the possibility of former National Assembly Vice Speaker Chung Jin-suk, a former chief of staff to President Yoon, receiving a nomination for Chungcheongnam-do's Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, incumbent Chungcheongnam-do Governor Kim Tae-heum, who is seeking re-election, reportedly conveyed to the party leadership that such a move "effectively abandons the entire election not only in Chungcheong but also in the Seoul metropolitan area." Governor Kim is said to have even hinted at the possibility of running as an independent. The PPP has decided to postpone the nomination for this region and announce it on the 7th. It is known that the party will review whether former Vice Speaker Chung, who has been indicted in connection with the insurrection special counsel investigation, is eligible to participate in the party primary. (국민의힘은 이날 “면접 등에서 성적이 우수한 후보를 결정한 것”이라고 했지만, 이진숙, 이태규 후보 등 윤석열 정부 인사들이 대거 공천을 받자 당내에서도 우려가 나왔다. 특히 윤 전 대통령의 비서실장 출신인 정진석 전 국회부의장의 충남 공주·부여·청양 공천 가능성이 나오면서, 연임에 도전하는 김태흠 충남지사 등은 당 지도부에 “충청은 물론 수도권까지 전체 선거를 사실상 포기한다는 것”이라는 입장을 전달한 것으로 알려졌다. 김 지사는 무소속 출마 가능성까지 내비쳤다고 한다. 국민의힘은 일단 이 지역 공천을 보류하고 오는 7일 발표하기로 했다. 내란 특검에 기소된 정 전 부의장이 당내 경선 자격이 있는지 여부를 심사할 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Jeong Visits Lee Won-taek Amid 'Tab Payment' Controversy… Across the Street, a Rally Cries "Resign" (‘술값 대납’ 논란 이원택 찾은 鄭… 맞은편에선 “사퇴하라” 집회)
item.description:
Democratic Party of Korea leader Jeong Cheong-rae attended the opening ceremony of Jeonbuk Governor candidate Lee Won-taek's campaign office in Jeonju, North Jeolla Province, on the 1st. This move comes as support for Lee, who pushed through his nomination despite allegations of covering meal and drink expenses. The party conducted an ethics investigation when the controversy arose during the primary but concluded there were "no suspicions." Lee is classified as a pro-Jeong (pro-Jeong Cheong-rae) faction member. (더불어민주당 정청래 대표가 1일 전북 전주시에서 열린 이원택 전북지사 후보 선거사무소 개소식에 참석했다. ‘술·식사비 대납' 의혹에도 공천을 강행한 이 후보 지원에 나선 것이다. 당은 경선 과정에서 의혹이 불거지자 윤리감찰을 시행했지만 “혐의 없음” 결론을 내렸다. 이 후보는 친청(친정청래)계로 분류된다.)

On that day, Jeong actively praised Lee. He said, "Looking at how he takes care of his district, he's truly a passionate and tenacious candidate," adding, "Aren't the residents of North Jeolla lucky to have such a governor candidate?" He went on to promise stronger support, stating, "If the Special Act on North Jeolla Self-Governing Province is strengthened and investments are made in the Saemangeum development, it will become a seed for North Jeolla's growth." Lee responded, "I will form a triangular alliance with President Lee Jae-myung and Representative Jeong to secure central government budgets, policies, and new industries." <<> At the same time, a rally criticizing Jeong and Lee was held across the street from the campaign office. About 30 to 40 party members chanted slogans such as "Jeong Cheong-rae, resign!" and "Lee Won-taek, resign!" Earlier, lawmaker Ahn Ho-young, who had competed against Lee, went on a 12-day hunger strike demanding a re-investigation of the allegations. Meanwhile, current North Jeolla Governor Kim Kwan-young, who was expelled from the party over suspicions of paying proxy fees, is considering running as an independent. That day, Lee targeted Ahn and the rally participants, saying, "Even though we anticipated the rally, (Jeong) came to support us. After the primary, people must accept the results." <<> Within the Democratic Party, some interpret Jeong's visit to his home turf of Jeonju amid nationwide campaign support as "an election campaign for the party leadership's re-election," while others see it as "a message to break through the nomination controversy head-on." <<> On the 4th, Jeong will visit Busan to accompany candidate Ha Jung-woo, who is running in the by-election for Buk-gu Gap, on a trip to Gupo Market. Recently, Ha faced controversy after being captured wiping his hand after shaking hands with a market vendor. On the 3rd, Jeong will also attend the opening ceremony of Gyeongnam Governor candidate Kim Kyoung-soo's campaign office in Changwon. (정 대표는 이날 이 후보를 적극 치켜세웠다. 그는 “지역구를 챙기는 모습을 보면 정말 열정적이고 집념 있게 일하는 후보”라며 “이런 도지사 후보를 둔 전북 도민들은 복 받은 것 아니겠느냐”고 말했다. 이어 “전북특별자치도법이 더 강화되고 새만금 개발 관련해 앞으로 투자되면 전북 발전의 씨앗이 될 것”이라며 지원 강화를 약속했다. 이 후보는 “이재명 대통령, 정 대표와 삼각편대를 만들어 중앙정부 예산과 정책, 신산업을 만들어가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Pursuing a Special Counsel Gives Hope Seeds to the People Power Party"... Ruling Party Candidates in Yeongnam Region Anxious (“특검 추진, 국힘에 희망 씨앗 준 것”… 與 영남 후보들 전전긍긍)
item.description:
With the June 3 local elections about a month away, the so-called "fabricated indictment special counsel law," which would allow President Lee Jae-myung to drop all charges in cases where he has been indicted, is beginning to emerge as a campaign issue. From the National Assembly's handling of the special counsel bill to the President's approval and the appointment of a special counsel, this issue is expected to play out over a considerable period. (6·3 지방선거를 한 달여 앞둔 가운데, 이재명 대통령이 기소된 모든 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있는 이른바 ‘조작 기소 특검법’이 선거 쟁점으로 떠오르기 시작했다. 특검법 본회의 처리, 이 대통령의 특검법 재가와 특검 임명에 이르기까지 이 이슈는 상당 기간 굴러갈 것으로 보인다.)

The Democratic Party leadership claims that "the special counsel law will have no significant impact on the elections." However, campaign teams for Democratic candidates in the Yeongnam region, classified as battlegrounds, are privately expressing concerns that "it will affect the elections," even if they don't say so publicly. Similar sentiments have emerged from some candidate camps in the Chungcheong region. Conversely, candidates from the People Power Party on the 1st uniformly condemned the "fabricated indictment special counsel" and are pushing a "judgment on the administration" narrative. (민주당 지도부는 “특검법이 선거에 별 영향이 없을 것”이라고 하고 있다. 그러나 접전지로 분류되는 영남권의 민주당 후보 캠프들은 공개적으로 언급하진 않지만 “선거에 영향이 미칠 것”이라고 우려하고 있다. 비슷한 목소리는 충청권의 일부 후보 진영에서도 흘러나왔다. 반대로 국민의힘 후보들은 1일 일제히 ‘조작 기소 특검’을 비난하며 ‘정권 심판론’을 띄우고 있다.)

People Power Party Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon said on the same day, "This crosses a line that should never be crossed, and then some," adding, "It's like shouting to the people that 'the president is a criminal.'" Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon stated, "They might as well declare that the president is the state and the law," and urged, "A strong wave of public resistance must arise." Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho said on KBS Radio, "There will definitely be a backlash." (국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장 후보는 이날 “넘지 말아야 할 선을 넘어도 한참 넘었다”며 “국민에게 ‘대통령은 범죄자’라고 외치는 꼴”이라고 했다. 박형준 부산시장 후보는 “차라리 짐이 곧 국가요 법이라고 선언하라”며 “강력한 국민적 저항이 일어나야 한다”고 했다. 추경호 대구시장 후보는 KBS 라디오에서 “반드시 역풍이 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

Seoul, Busan, and Daegu are regions that will determine the outcome of these local elections. Current analysis suggests that, as the first election since the inauguration of the Lee Jae-myung administration a year ago, the Democratic Party holds the advantage or is in a neck-and-neck race. A political insider commented, "The process of the Democratic Party forcing through the 'fabricated indictment' special counsel and the president approving it could influence voter sentiment, such as rallying conservatives and stirring up undecided voters," adding, "It has essentially given hope to People Power Party candidates." (서울·부산·대구는 이번 지방선거의 승리 여부를 판가름할 지역이다. 현재 판세는 이재명 정부 출범 1년 만에 치러지는 선거로 민주당이 우세하거나 백중세로 분석된다. 정치권 관계자는 “민주당이 ‘조작 기소’ 특검을 강행 처리하고 대통령이 이를 재가하는 일련의 과정이 보수 결집과 부동층 자극 등 표심에 영향을 미칠 수 있다”며 “국민의힘 후보들에게 희망을 준 셈”이라고 했다.)

However, figures within the Democratic Party leadership maintain that the impact of the 'fabricated indictment' special counsel law on the elections is not a significant concern. Lawmaker Han Byeong-do, effectively confirmed as the next floor leader, said on SBS Radio the same day, "Since the circumstances of the fabricated indictment were revealed through the National Assembly's audit, it is only natural for the special counsel to investigate the truth," and "The power to drop charges is granting the special counsel discretion when evidence comes to light." (그러나 민주당 지도부 인사들은 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법이 선거에 미치는 영향이 걱정할 정도는 아니라는 입장이다. 차기 원내대표로 사실상 확정된 한병도 의원은 이날 SBS 라디오에서 “국회 국정조사를 통해 조작 기소 정황이 드러났기 때문에 특검의 진상 규명은 당연한 것”이라며 “공소 취소 권한은 증거가 나왔을 때 특검에 판단 권한을 준 것”이라고 했다.)

A Democratic Party lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area remarked, "Unlike presidential or general elections, local elections are about assessing who can better handle local issues, who is well-connected with the central government, and who is beneficial to the region," adding, "Even if the opposition parties push a special counsel judgment narrative, how many people would actually change the candidate they originally planned to vote for?" Another lawmaker said, "This special counsel law is also necessary to consolidate our support base," and predicted, "It will work in our favor in the elections." (민주당 수도권 의원은 “지방선거는 대선·총선과 달리 지역 현안에 누가 더 잘 대응할지, 누가 중앙정부와 잘 연결되고 지역에 유리할지를 판단하는 선거”라며 “야당이 특검 심판론을 내세운다고 해서, 원래 뽑을 후보를 바꾸는 사람이 얼마나 되겠느냐”고 했다. 다른 의원은 “이번 특검법은 우리 지지층 결집을 위해서도 꼭 필요하다”며 “선거에 유리하게 작용할 것”이라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the Democratic Party has repeatedly pushed through legislation that the People Power Party has labeled as "blanket legislation to protect the president." Despite this, President Lee has maintained an approval rating in the 60% range, and factors such as internal strife within the People Power Party have shaped the electoral landscape in favor of the Democratic Party. (그동안 민주당은 국민의힘이 ‘이 대통령을 위한 방탄 입법’이라고 규정한 법안을 수차례 강행 처리해왔다. 그럼에도 이 대통령이 60%대 지지율을 유지하고, 국민의힘 내분 등으로 선거 지형은 민주당에 유리하게 조성됐다.)

However, experts believe the 'fabricated indictment special counsel' issue could be different. They predict it will particularly impact the Yeongnam region, including Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province, and Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang Province, where support for the Democratic and People Power parties is relatively even. In a survey conducted by Korea Information Research and Cheonji Ilbo on the 27th and 28th of last month, support for the "special counsel's authority to drop charges" stood at 42.9%, with opposition at 38.1%, within the margin of error. However, in Daegu/North Gyeongsang and Busan/Ulsan/South Gyeongsang, opposition rates were 48.2% and 46.2%, respectively, exceeding support rates of 37.6% and 37.8%. (하지만 전문가들은 이번 ‘조작 기소 특검’ 이슈는 다를 수 있다고 보고 있다. 일단 민주당과 국민의힘 정당 지지율이 비슷한 대구·경북, 부산·울산·경남 등 영남권에 영향을 미칠 것이란 전망이다. 코리아정보리서치·천지일보의 지난달 27~28일 조사에서 ‘특검의 공소 취소 권한’에 대한 찬성은 42.9%, 반대가 38.1%로 오차 범위 안이었지만, 대구·경북과 부산·울산·경남은 각각 반대가 48.2%, 46.2%로, 찬성 37.6%, 37.8%를 웃돌았다.)

Democratic Party candidate camps in the Yeongnam region are finding the situation troublesome. In Daegu, Democratic candidate Kim Boo-kyum and People Power candidate Choo Kyung-ho are in a tight race. A Democratic Party official in Daegu commented, "As if Daegu didn't already see a late consolidation of conservatives, the 'fabricated indictment special counsel' seems to have poured gasoline on the fire." (영남권의 민주당 후보 캠프들은 곤혹스러워하고 있다. 대구의 경우 민주당 김부겸 후보와 국민의힘 추경호 후보가 접전 중이다. 대구의 한 민주당 관계자는 “안 그래도 대구는 막판 보수 결집이 있는데, ‘조작 기소 특검’이 기름을 부은 것 같다”고 했다.)

In Busan, Democratic candidate Jeon Jae-soo maintains a lead within or near the margin of error over People Power candidate Park Hyung-joon, but the gap fluctuates depending on the poll. The situation is similar in the South Gyeongsang Province gubernatorial race. Democratic candidate Kim Kyung-soo and People Power candidate Park Wan-soo are in a close battle within the margin of error in various polls. An official from a Democratic candidate camp in the Yeongnam region lamented, "In the midst of all this, it's like we've been hit by a nuclear bomb with the 'fabricated indictment special counsel,'" and added, "I'm extremely worried about the poll results next week." (부산은 민주당 전재수 후보가 국민의힘 박형준 후보를 오차 범위 안팎에서 앞서는 추세가 유지되는 가운데, 여론조사에 따라 그 격차가 들쭉날쭉한 상황이다. 경남지사 선거 상황도 비슷하다. 민주당 김경수·국민의힘 박완수 후보는 각종 여론조사에서 오차 범위 안 접전을 벌이고 있다. 영남권 민주당 후보 캠프의 한 관계자는 “이런 와중에 ‘조작 기소 특검’이란 핵폭탄을 맞은 격”이라며 “다음 주 여론조사 결과가 몹시 걱정된다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk to Visit Daegu and Busan… Attends Only Campaign Office Openings Without On-Site Schedules (장동혁, 대구·부산행… 현장 방문 일정 없이 캠프 개소식만 참석)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, will visit Busan and Daegu this weekend, where independent election campaign committees have been formed separately from the party leadership. The People Power Party announced on the 1st that Chairman Jang will attend the opening ceremonies of the campaign offices for Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon on the 2nd and Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho on the 3rd. Amid growing demands for Jang to step back into a secondary role following the formation of the party’s central election campaign committee, this will be the first time Jang attends a candidate’s campaign office opening. <<> Jang’s side stated, “Daegu and Busan are crucial conservative strongholds for the People Power Party in the upcoming local elections,” adding, “He has decided to attend in person.” Jang is expected to have no external schedules, such as on-site visits, aside from the opening ceremonies. In a February interview with the Chosun Ilbo, Jang said, “The standard for victory or defeat in the June 3 local elections is the Seoul and Busan mayoral races,” and “Jang Dong-hyuk’s political future depends on it.” However, he was not invited to the Seoul Party’s Unity Rally held on the 30th of last month, which was attended by Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon and others. <<> The campaign teams for candidates Park Hyung-joon and Choo Kyung-ho stated, “Not only Chairman Jang but the entire party leadership will be attending.” At the opening of Park’s campaign office on the 2nd, in addition to Jang, the party leadership, including floor leader Song Eon-seok and senior lawmakers Shin Dong-uk, Kim Min-soo, and Jo Gwang-han, will be present in full force. Park’s side remarked, “Former Minister of Employment and Labor Kim Moon-soo, whom we have appointed as honorary election committee chairman, and former National Assembly Speaker Chung Ui-hwa will also attend,” adding, “Please understand this as a dimension of conservative grand unity, driven by a sense of duty to defend the Nakdong River front.” <<> At the opening of Choo’s campaign office on the 3rd, Jang, floor leader Song, senior lawmakers Shin Dong-uk and Woo Jae-jun, along with many incumbent National Assembly members from the Daegu region, will also attend in large numbers. On that day, candidate Choo, together with Gyeongbuk governor candidate Lee Cheol-woo, visited and paid respects at the birthplace of Park Chung-hee in Gumi, Gyeongbuk, and issued a joint declaration. The two candidates, who had earlier discussed forming a separate Daegu-Gyeongbuk integrated election committee independent from the central one, stated, “A virtual joint election committee is already in operation.” <<> Meanwhile, former Minister of Employment and Labor Kim Moon-soo was appointed on this day as the permanent election campaign committee chairman for People Power Party candidate Yoo Eui-dong, who is running in the by-election for the National Assembly seat in Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province. Former Minister Kim also concurrently serves as the honorary election committee chairman for regional government head candidates in seven areas, including Busan, Daegu, Incheon, Ulsan, Sejong, Gangwon, and Gyeongbuk. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 이번 주말 당 지도부와 별개로 독자적 선거대책위원회를 꾸린 부산과 대구를 찾는다. 국민의힘은 장 대표가 오는 2일 박형준 부산시장 후보, 3일 추경호 대구시장 후보 선거 사무실 개소식에 참석한다고 1일 밝혔다. 당 중앙선거대책위원회 구성을 둘러싸고 장 대표에 대한 2선 후퇴 요구가 분출하는 상황에서, 장 대표가 후보 선거 사무실 개소식에 참석하는 건 이번이 처음이다.)

item.title: Justice Party “Cannot Agree to Special Counsel”… Cho Kuk Innovation Party “Needs Discussion” (정의당 “특검 동의 못해”… 조국혁신당 “논의 필요”)
item.description:
The Justice Party issued a statement on the 1st regarding the Democratic Party of Korea’s proposed “fabricated indictment” special counsel bill, stating, “It would result in appointing a special counsel where President Lee Jae-myung holds the authority to withdraw charges in his own case,” and added, “We cannot agree to this in any way.” This marks a clear opposition stance from a pro-opposition party toward the special counsel bill. Meanwhile, the Cho Kuk Innovation Party and the Progressive Party, both parliamentary parties, did not release any statements on the day. Officials from both parties said, “We will decide on a position after further discussion.” (정의당은 1일 성명을 내고 더불어민주당이 발의한 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법안에 대해 “이재명 대통령이 본인 사건 공소 취소 권한을 갖는 특검을 임명하는 꼴”이라며 “결코 동의할 수 없다”고 했다. 친여 성향 정당이 특검법안에 반대 입장을 명확히 한 것이다. 이날 원내 정당인 조국혁신당과 진보당은 아무런 입장을 내지 않았다. 두 정당 관계자는 “좀 더 논의해 보고 입장을 내겠다”고 했다.)

The Justice Party stated, “Although this is called the ‘Yoon Suk Yeol Regime Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Law,’ most of the investigation targets are directly or indirectly related to President Lee Jae-myung,” adding, “It allows the head of the executive branch to determine the continuation of judicial proceedings, undermining the fundamental principle of separation of powers in the constitutional order.” They further argued, “Above all, this sets a precedent where legislative power abuses special counsel laws to shield the president and disrupts judicial procedures,” and warned, “It will also place a significant political burden on the president.” They concluded, “The Democratic Party should immediately stop this unreasonable move and prove President Lee’s innocence through proper legal procedures.” (정의당은 이날 “‘윤석열 정권 조작 기소 특검법’이라고 이름은 붙였지만, 수사 대상은 이재명 대통령과 직간접적으로 관련된 것들이 대부분”이라며 “행정부 수장이 사법 절차의 존속 여부를 결정하는 것으로, 헌정 질서의 기본적인 권력 분립 원칙을 훼손하는 일”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “무엇보다 입법 권력이 대통령 엄호의 목적으로 특검법을 남용하고 사법 절차를 뒤흔드는 선례”라며 “대통령에게도 막대한 정치적 부담으로 돌아오게 될 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “민주당은 무리수를 즉각 중단하고, 사법 절차에 따라 이 대통령의 무죄를 증명하라”고 했다.)

The Cho Kuk Innovation Party did not release a statement on the day. A party official stated, “We agree on the need for charge withdrawal, but under current law, the Prosecutors General directs charge withdrawals,” and added, “Whether to cooperate with handling this bill, which does not follow that, requires discussion.” The official also noted that the Democratic Party’s special counsel bill designates the Cho Kuk Innovation Party to recommend one special counsel candidate, saying, “This was done without any consultation with us.” (조국혁신당은 이날 입장을 밝히지 않았다. 당 관계자는 “공소 취소 필요성에는 공감하지만, 공소 취소는 현행법상 검찰총장이 지휘하게 돼 있다”며 “그렇지 않은 이 법안 처리에 협조할지 여부는 논의가 필요하다”고 했다. 특히 민주당 특검법에 조국혁신당이 특검 후보를 1명 추천하게 돼 있는 것도 “우리와 아무런 상의 없이 이뤄진 것”이라고 했다.)

The Progressive Party also did not issue a statement. A party official said, “The party’s resources are fully mobilized for local election candidates, and since May 1st is Labor Day, there was insufficient time to discuss the related bill,” but added, “Personally, I believe there is a problem with the president appointing a special counsel who can withdraw charges in his own case. Further discussion at the party level is needed.” An opposition party official stated, “If the Cho Kuk Innovation Party with 12 seats and the Progressive Party with 4 seats do not actively cooperate, the Democratic Party will face a very difficult situation.” (진보당도 성명을 내지 않았다. 진보당 관계자는 “지방선거 후보들에게 당력이 총동원돼 있는 데다, 5월 1일이 노동절인 관계로 관련 법안에 대해 논의할 시간이 부족했다”면서도 “개인적으로는 대통령이 자신의 사건을 공소 취소할 수도 있는 특검을 지명하는 건 문제가 있다는 생각이다. 당 차원의 논의는 더 해봐야 한다”고 했다. 여권 관계자는 “만약 12석의 조국혁신당과 4석의 진보당이 적극 협조하지 않는다면 민주당으로선 매우 난감한 상황이 될 것”이라고 했다.)
